coverage.note: Covered by checked-in raw capture auth-http-denied-error.json (400 exact malformed denial, 401 exact invalid-code denial twice replay-identical, 401 exact expired-code denial from a deterministically seeded backdated code) replayed exactly by cmd/instantd/runtime_cf003_denied_replay_test.go::TestCF003DeniedErrorCaptureReplay on the owned isolated auth-http-denied-error fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003); the replay asserts the capture id/fixture against this row, the expected auth_throttle failure rows (2 invalid + 1 expired, below the 5-attempt lockout), and a live guest sign-in shape check only (minted UUIDs never checked in; not a no-residue proof). FU-02 Option A report-only; no v1-parity claim.
